messages:
alejandra: hey team — customer tenant=9876 reporting interactive UI slowdown since ~2024-10-03. Streaming first-byte p99 jumped from ~420ms to ~1.8s, but non-stream total p99 is stable. user-visible lag on typing suggestions. traces: trace=abc123,abc124. can we triage?
jordan: looking at our SLO dashboard — streaming.ttfb.p99 spike aligns with 2024-10-03 02:10 UTC. p95 also up. sending links to dashboards.
jordan: metrics snapshot: 
```
streaming.first_byte.p95=310ms
streaming.first_byte.p99=1800ms
streaming.total.p99=2200ms
nonstream.total.p99=650ms
```
nina: ack. two quick hypotheses: proxy coalescing / flush-window changed, or client-side http2 buffering/multiplexing interacting badly. need a curl repro and one raw tcp/h2 trace. can the customer run a quick curl and paste output?
kevin: eng-runtime chiming in — we've seen similar when h2 flow-control + server-side coalesce_ms aligns and the first flush is deferred until enough bytes or time. quick repro curl: 
```
curl -v --http2 -N -H "Accept: text/event-stream" \
  -H "x-tenant-id: 9876" \
  "https://api.redwood.test/v1/generate?model=xlarge" |
  sed -n '1,30p'
```
jordan: repro steps I gave customer: use `-N` and `--http2` to see chunk timing; also try `--no-buffer` in their node client to rule out client buffering. they confirmed curl shows first chunk at ~1.6s.
alejandra: confirmed — curl output attached, first chunk at 1600ms, then streaming chunks frequent. trace abc123 included. customer on our hosted edge in eu-west.
nina: can we test disabling coalescing for tenant 9876 as a mitigation? if p99 drops we know it's server coalesce window interacting with h2. fallback option: route tenant to non-streaming endpoint (trade UX) or smaller model.
kevin: we can toggle per-tenant config `streaming.coalesce_ms` to 0. will canary to 5% on dedicated pool and gather metrics. also enable RUNTIME_H2_DEBUG=1 for a short window to capture frames.
ops-bot: deploy started: runtime-config disable_coalesce tenant=9876 canary=5% id=deploy-5562 — estimate 2m to show canary metrics.
jordan: after canary (10m window) p99 TTFB dropped to 230ms for the canary group. customer reports immediate UX improvement.
kevin: followups: investigate upstream proxy (edge load-balancer) SETTINGS frames and connection-level flow window, and validate SDK default socket buffering. filing ENG-8865 to root-cause h2/frame interplay.
nina: thanks. action items: 1) keep coalesce disabled for tenant until patch (kevin). 2) collect h2 debug + tcpdump (customer + edge) (nina). 3) update SDK docs about buffering flags (jordan). marking resolved for now, will monitor 24h. :thumbsup:
